args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded
recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Affected versions are
<2.9.4, so this bumps the pin to 2.9.4, the fixed release in the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

Per the advisory, all versions <2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 is the fixed release in the 2.x line, so this bumps the pin one minor version to stay on 2.x. No other dependencies changed.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**
- No code changes; dependency-only upgrade.

@alex please review.
args.head: fix/cve-2026-31337-fastjson
